about: Hand-kept source for What came first? (What happened first?). The events, their windows and order facts are the Timeline sort game's (src/data/timeline/timeline.json, never changed here); this file holds only this game's own exclusions and blocks. Built by scripts/build-what-came-first.ts into events.json; edit here, then rebuild.

blockedGroups.name: the Creation week
blockedGroups.reason: The order of what God made in the Creation week is left out of this game (owner, 2026-11-12).

blockedGroups.name: Jesus's miracles
blockedGroups.reason: Which of Jesus's miracles came first is left out (owner, 2026-11-12): the gospels often do not settle the order. His first sign (John 2:11) is a Bible First instead.

blockedGroups.name: the plagues
blockedGroups.reason: The order of the plagues is left out of this game (owner, 2026-11-12).

blocked.reason: Rests on Hezekiah's first year: 729 BC counting a shared reign with Ahaz (Thiele), but 715 BC on Albright's dates, after Samaria fell.
John puts the anointing the day before the entry (John 12:1, 12), but Matthew and Mark tell the Bethany anointing after it (Matthew 26:6; Mark 14:3).
